title: From Neuroscience to AI: Exploring the Potential of the Artificial Cerebellum
content: This review explores how artificial intelligence (AI) is being used to model the cerebellum, with its various applications such as movement, coordination, and learning. It analyzes current research on its architecture and cell types, especially the Purkinje cell, highlighting how they inspire new AI designs. These models aim to replicate the cerebellum ability to adapt and operate with real-time precision. While there are promising advances in areas such as robotics, more work is still needed to address complex functions such as emotional and cognitive processes.
